# quote_key { #crossrepo.manifest.quote_key }

```python
crossrepo.manifest.quote_key(key)
```

Write a manifest key the way YAML needs it written.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**key**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Key as a path.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The key, quoted when it holds a character that would otherwise change what it means -- a glob, a leading indicator, a colon.
